morbi.headline: Morbi ceramics faces severe export drops despite relief from falling container freight rates.
what_changed: Morbi's ceramic exports dropped by Rs 3,589 crore over six months due to the Iran war.
Ocean container freight rates dropped by up to 50 percent, providing cost relief for exporters.
Somany Ceramics announced plans for a 5 MSM capacity hike via debottlenecking.
stress_signals: Rs 3,589 crore drop in Morbi ceramic exports over six months linked to the war in Iran [19f71f3185bc]
Broader ceramic tile industry confronting export market challenges and rising production cost pressures [895aa138960b]
improvement_signals: Container freight rates dropped up to 50 percent for Morbi ceramic exporters [d6c30857de2c]
what_to_watch: Location details, capex amount, funding mix, and timelines for Somany Ceramics' 5 MSM debottlenecking expansion [0f642d309dd8]
Working capital stretch and inventory build-up in export-focused OEM suppliers and units
Sustainability of lower container freight rates across key export trade lanes

surat.headline: Surat shows mixed festive signals: diamond revival vs fabric oversupply and payment defaults.
what_changed: Surat Textile Policy approved 627 units representing Rs 1,521 crore in investments, while MANTRA launched MedTech testing services.
Diamond segment experiences early reopening plans and strong lab-grown diamond (LGD) festive demand despite pre-Diwali rough diamond shortages.
MMF textile demand remains muted overall, forcing Sayan weavers to plan a 15-day production cut of 60 crore meters.
stress_signals: Sayan weaving zone units face financial crisis, planning a collective vacation to cut production by 60 crore meters [297b184838d2].
Textile jobworkers and merchants report severe payment defaults, including a ₹1.5 crore jobworker default [6a3068dc8bf1] and Rs 22 lakh trade fraud [f699b1f05b5e].
SGCCI demands strict GUJCTOC application against organized fraud gangs causing widespread market defaults [421d4bf835f5].
Rough diamond shortages triggered pre-Diwali unit closures [b65b93c4b724], alongside a tragic suicide of a local diamond merchant [9edf027a29a8].
improvement_signals: Surat Textile Policy approved 627 units and Rs 1,521 crore investment [021c037e28d9].
Diamond units plan early reopening on improving demand [bd78e4a130ff], with Lab-Grown Diamond (LGD) units offering 10% bonuses to workers [751cd1661531].
SGCCI signed two export-boosting MoUs in Morocco [472a28abf217], and Fanti Satin sarees saw strong festive retail traction in Karauli [ee1efdbd9539].
what_to_watch: Account-level working capital blockages among textile jobworkers impacted by market payment defaults.
Impact of the Textile Ministry's capacity database drive and Fire Department Diwali passage-clearance compliance on market operations.
Execution and financial flows for the 627 newly approved units under the Surat Textile Policy.
